sentences.en: Our competitive position is weakened by the rising labor cost.
sentences.zh: 高昂的人力成本削弱了我们的竞争地位。

sentences.en: The storm will weaken during the course of the day.
The Greek slaves have weakened our children with their writings.
sentences.zh: 这些希腊奴隶通过他们的文字削弱了我们的孩子。

senses.zh: （使）削弱,（使）变弱,衰减,变得优柔寡断
